name: Shiloh Custom Molding
old_description: From production to delivery, we provide precise, cost-effective molding solutions with expert finishing and drop ship support—all backed by family-owned care.
about:
Shiloh Custom Molding operates from Paris, Arkansas, where it was founded in 1996. The company is family-owned and operated by four partners, including three brothers—Seth, John, and Jesse Green—alongside William Heffington. The business began with a focus on rotational molding and has grown to offer full-service solutions from production to fulfillment.

The company runs two rotational molding machines to produce hollow plastic parts such as tanks, enclosures, bins, housings, and custom components. In addition to molding, Shiloh provides in-house finishing services for surface texture control and operates a drop-ship fulfillment program that stores finished parts and ships directly to end customers. The firm coordinates mold fabrication with trusted partners and maintains molds in-house to ensure consistent quality. Production runs are flexible, accommodating prototype batches through large-scale orders.

Shiloh serves a range of industries including automotive, industrial equipment, medical and dental, consumer products, agriculture, marine, construction, and electronics. Current clients include Terracast Products, Mullet Tools, and Shure-Step, for whom the company produces items such as recreational coolers, kayaks, and industrial step products.

The partners emphasize a hands-on, family-owned approach that prioritizes craftsmanship, responsive service, and low overhead to keep pricing competitive. They cite in-house texture control, drop-ship logistics, and efficient production planning as key differentiators that allow them to deliver consistent quality and reliable turnaround.
